	<!-- Zaton -->
<string id="zat_a2_base_alarm">
	<text>Pozor, stalkerove! Skadovsk je pod utokem! Museli jsme se uzavrit, dokud se situace neuklidni.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_base_guard_1">
	<text>Poloz to zbran, kamo. Toto je nase taboriste, tady ji nepotrebujes.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_base_guard_2">
	<text>Hele, kamo, tady je to tak poklidne, jak jen to jde. Schovej svoji zbran a udrzme to tak.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_base_guard_3">
	<text>Pozor, zbrane jsou k zabijeni mutantu a tady zadne nenajdes. Tak ji schovej, jo?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_base_relax">
	<text>Pozor, stalkerove! Dvere do Skadovska jsou vam znovu otevreny.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_linker_b29_take_order">
	<text>Skvele! Tady je hotovost.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_after_surge">
	<text>Stalkeri, emise je konecne za nami. Doufam, ze jste v poradku.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_farewell_1">
	<text>Prijd, kdyz se objevi neco zajimaveho. Skadovsk tu zustane, to je jiste...</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_farewell_2">
	<text>Prijd, kdyz najdes artefakty, uvidime, co s nimi dokazeme udelat.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_farewell_angry_1">
	<text>Uz jsme hotovi? ... Ano? Dobra... Vychod je tamhle.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_farewell_angry_2">
	<text>Jasne, jasne... Jdi uz. Starat se o pijavice neni na me priorite.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_greeting_1">
	<text>Ahoj! Co te sem privedlo na nasi skromnou lod?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_greeting_2">
	<text>Vitej na nasi bazine, ledoborec!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_greeting_angry_1">
	<text>Lod je tu uz hodne dlouho, ale je to porad plne krys. K cemu vdecime za tuhle pochybnou radost?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_greeting_angry_2">
	<text>Co chces?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_surge_phase_1">
	<text>Pozor stalkri! Blizi se emise! Opakuji, blizi se emise! Okamzite se schovat!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a2_stalker_barmen_surge_phase_2">
	<text>Pozor stalkri! Emise zacne v jakoukoli chvili. Najdete ukryt, pokud chcete zit!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_a23_about_x8">
	<text>Dokumenty se odkazuji na centralni laborator oznacenou jako X8, ktera by mohla obsahovat informace o tajnych experimentech provadenych v Zone. Nasi analytici se touto otazkou jiz delsi dobu zabyvaji.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b100_heli_2_maps">
	<text>Vypada to, ze posadka zemrela ve vzduchu a vrtulnik jednoduse havaroval, protoze nikdo ho neovladal. Palubni pocitac mel o trochu vetsi stesti. Zajimalo by me, jestli zde neni neco uzitecneho... Ah, tady je neco...! Mapa oblasti s oznacenymi urcitymi misty. To se muze hodit.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b101_both_heli_info">
	<text>Elektronika je zde stejna, ale system ochrany pred emisemi je nedotceny. Co by to mohlo zpusobit?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b101_one_heli_info">
	<text>Vsechna elektronika uvnitr vyhorela. Dokonce i plast napajeciho kabelu je roztaveny.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_come_here_now">
	<text>Tak, to je lepsi! Ted sem muzes prijit a promluvime si.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_count_1">
	<text>Jedna!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_count_2">
	<text>Dve!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_count_3">
	<text>Tri!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_hide_weapon_1">
	<text>Schovej svoji zbran!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_hide_weapon_2">
	<text>Rekl jsem ti, aby jsi schoval svoji zbran. Budu do tri pocitat a pokud to neudelas, rozdmycham ti hlavu!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_talk_to_commander_1">
		<text>Nemam chut placat jazykem. Mluv s velitelem!</text>
	</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_talk_to_commander_2">
<text>Pokud se neco objevi, promluv s velitelem.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b103_merc_warning">
<text>Jsi blby nebo co? Ustup, nez ti vystrelim do mozku!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_dont_receipt_reward">
<text>Dobre, lidi, je cas se vratit. Jste k nicemu, takze neocekavejte odmenu.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_garmata_refuse_talk">
<text>Mluv s bossem. Vic jsem pro strileni nez pro reci.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_garmata_story_reply">
<text>Zeptal jsem se vsude, ale je to k nicemu. Nikdo nic nevi. Je to jako by byl poltergeist nebo neco podobneho.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_hunt_complete">
<text>Je hotovo. Nase prace je hotova, pojdme se vratit. Nezapomen zajit za Pastyrem do Janova a rict mu, ze zranena chimaera je porazena, abys dostal svoji cast.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_hunt_great">
<text>Skvele odvedeno! Mozna by ses mel stat lovce chimer jako povolani.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_hunt_kill">
<text>Jsme tam. Je to blizko, citim to. Kdyz ji uvidis, miri na hlavu. Ale nepriblizuj se moc, chimeri te citi na mili daleko, i kdyz spi.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_hunt_plan">
<text>Pozor! Chimera lovi v noci a rano se vraci do sveho ukrytu na odpocinek. Mohli bychom ji prekvapit pri svitani, kdyz odpociva. Staci se ji priblizit a zabit ji, dokud spi. Dost jednoduche. Ale musime vstavat brzy. Setkame se v baru v... 3 hodiny rano.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_hunt_sneak">
<text>Opatrne! Musime byt naprosto tisi, nesmi nas slyset.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_see_chimera">
<text>Ten parchant spi... Krab ti posila pozdrav. Hor!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_story_angry">
	<text>Ten parchant syn beh nechape, ze toho bude litovat.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_story_ask">
	<text>Tak, zjistil jsi neco o Magpie?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_story_calm">
	<text>Drz se tam, kamarade, doktor rekl, ze budes za par dni zase na nohou. Mohl bys vyuzit tenhle cas k odpocinku a relaxaci.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b106_gonta_to_actor">
	<text>Hej stalkre! Pojd sem! Mam pro tebe otazku.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_after_pay_snd_1">
	<text>Dobre! Ted se otoc pomalu a uz se ztrat zpatky tam, odkud jsi prisel!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_after_pay_snd_2">
	<text>Jses blbej, ne? Vypadni odsud!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_after_pay_snd_3">
	<text>Hej, hovado! Je tam vubec nekdo? Miz, nebo te sem a ted rozsekam!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_kill_actor_snd_1">
	<text>Plne te vysaje, svine!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_kill_actor_snd_2">
	<text>Klesnes, posranej hajzle!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_kill_actor_snd_3">
	<text>Dej mi artefakt, debile!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_punch">
	<text>Co za svine!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_stand_still_snd">
	<text>Zustan tam stat a ani nemysli na to, abys se hnul, ty hovado! Jedno spatne pohybu a jsi k nicemu!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_robbery_stop_snd">
	<text>Zastav tam! Schovaj zbran a nehni se!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_scene_1_give_item">
	<text>Hej, Vouse, podivej, co jsem nasel na te stare trosce! Tohle bude stacit?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_scene_1_linker_reply">
	<text>Wow, to je neco uplne jineho...! Nikdy jsem takovou vec nevidel. Tady, vem si tohle.</text>
	</string>
<string id="zat_b14_scene_1_stalker_bye">
	<text>Dekuji. Pokud mate jeste nejakou praci, vite, kde me najdete.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_scene_1_stalker_offended">
	<text>Jen se bezte dal. Urcite si na tenhle okamzik vzpomenete.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b14_scene_1_stalker_teach_actor">
	<text>Ach, jsi to ty... No, penize potrebuji stejne jako ty.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_breakdown">
	<text>Aah... Tohle je to! Je to konec! Jsou tu... mutanti... vsude mutanti!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_gave_first_artefact">
	<text>Tahle hovadina te nezachrani, az ti mutanti zacnou lezou ze vsech koutu. Tady, vezmi si to a zmiz mi z oci!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_gave_second_artefact">
	<text>Ha! Myslis si, ze te to ochrani pred emisi? Tady, vezmi si to a utec. Zachran si zadek!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_go_away">
	<text>Tak zmiz, podivine!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_greetings_1">
	<text>Do pekla, zatraceni mutanti!!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_greetings_2">
	<text>Vypadnete odsud, parchanti, nebo vas vsechny sestrelim!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_greetings_3">
	<text>Mrchy mutanti... Odpadnete!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_no_talk_1">
	<text>Nechte me byt.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_no_talk_2">
	<text>Jdete dal.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b18_noah_no_talk_3">
	<text>Vypadnete.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b20_noah_instructions">
	<text>Dobre pozoruj a nasleduj me.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b20_noah_jumped">
	<text>Skvela prace! Klidne se nekdy stav.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b20_noah_pda">
	<text>Takze tam jsou ti proklati mutanti. Vylezli na plosinu s tim, ze si mysli, ze je Noah nedostane. Asi nevi, ze mam vlastni cestu tam nahoru od severni farmy. Ceka te zabavna jizda, parchanti!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b215_stalker_guide_farewell_1">
	<text>No tak, hodne stesti!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b215_stalker_guide_farewell_2">
	<text>Dobrou prestrelku!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b215_stalker_guide_greeting_1">
	<text>Ahoj.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b215_stalker_guide_greeting_2">
	<text>Hele, stalker. Jak se mas?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b22_stalker_medic_diary">
	<text>Zaznam 12. Moje vyzkum se brzy uzavre... Lide v tabore zacinaji neco tusit. Grouse s Danilou planuji jit lovit nejake vysavace krve... Zajimalo by me, kdy si toho vsimnou? Musim seradit sklenice s krvi, abych zjistil, ktere jsou kontaminovane... A zbytek schovat... Nekdo jde... Zaznam 13. Mozna muj posledni. Nejprve ten zvedavy lovec a ted jeste Grouse. S timto neutecu. Prijdou pro me. Vim to... Ale vlastne je to jedno... Tato zavislost na hemoglobinu me brzy zabije. Radeji zemru od kulky nez na nemoc.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b22_stalker_medic_farewell_1">
	<text>Ano, jiste. Sbohem.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b22_stalker_medic_farewell_2">
	<text>Sbohem.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b22_stalker_medic_greeting_1">
	<text>Co se deje? Jsi zraneny nebo trpis radiaci?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b22_stalker_medic_greeting_2">
	<text>Ted ne, jo?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b22_stalker_medic_hello">
	<text>Vedel jsem, ze se nakonec prozradim... Jsem si jisty, ze mas spoustu otazek.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b28_heli_3_evacuation_points">
	<text>Informace na palubnim pocitaci... Dobra, Stingray-3 mel poruchu obou motoru. Hm... Co jeste?... Mapa s moznymi evakuacnimi misty. Pozice B2, B28 a B205. Zajimave.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b29_stalker_rival_1_order_ready">
	<text>Prace je hotova. Tady je artefakt.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b29_stalker_rival_2_order_ready">
	<text>Prace je hotova. Tady, vezmi si ten artefakt.</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_drink_no_more">
<text>Ahoj, stalkeru. Jak se dari?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_drunk">
<text>Ehm... Co chces...?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_drunk_discount">
<text>Ehm... Neco jsi zapomnel?</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_no_sleep_1">
<text>Hmm? Co...? Nech me spat...</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_no_sleep_2">
<text>No tak, nech me byt...!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_no_sleep_3">
<text>Je tam... Sluz si napojem!</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_realy_drunk">
<text>Co... Co ti muzu udelat?...</text>
</string>
<string id="zat_b3_tech_realy_drunk_discount">
<text>Aah... Ty jsi to... Vejdi!</text>

<string id="jup_b212_trapper_found_chimera">

<string id="jup_b221_duty_main_1">
	<text>No, navrhuji pripit na statecny tym muzu Duty, kteri byli poslani na predni linie, aby poradne zmlatili zeleny hnoj.</text>

<string id="jup_b221_duty_main_2">
	<text>Rekl jsem vam nekdy pribeh o Flintovi? Nejprve nastavil stalkerum past s chimerou, aby je napadla, potom nechal sveho partnera zemrit v anomalii a nakonec se pridal k Freedomu. Rekl bych, ze to je docela logicky zaver. Takze pripijime na nadeji, ze vsichni clenove Freedomu pujdou jeho cestou a my se postarame o ty, kdo zbyli.</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b221_duty_main_3">
	<text>Pijme na to, ze i v centru Zony jsou lide ochotni slouzit Dutu. Na nasi nove skupinu!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_main_4">
	<text>Zdvihuji sklenici na to, ze tento vyzkumny komplex je nyni plne chranen Dutou pred mutanti, anarchisty a dalsimi nizsimi tvory.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_main_5">
	<text>Kamaradi! Vypijme to na pocest nasich statecnych dobrovolniku, kteri provadeji mereni v nejnebezpecnejsich oblastech Zony pro nas vedecky pokrok.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_main_6">
	<text>Navrhuji pripitek pro bojovniky Duty, kteri statecne odrazili zbabely utok tech odpornych parchantu.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reaction_1">
	<text>Presne tak!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reaction_2">
	<text>Uplne souhlasim!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reaction_3">
	<text>Dobre receno!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reaction_4">
	<text>Nemohu vic souhlasit.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reply_1">
	<text>Uz je mrtvy. A kdyby to bylo na mne, nechal bych vsechny vas nasledovat. Naucil bych vas prestat vyvazet vyrobky Zony zahnanim tou samou chamtivosti.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reply_2">
	<text>Nikdo nevi, co se skutecne stalo. Nebyl jsi tam, abys to videl.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reply_3">
	<text>Je to skupina slozena z lidi z Monolitu? No, doufam, ze si take najdete skupinu krevsajru, protoze az to udelate, podplukovnik vas urcite prida na seznam nebezpecnych mutantu.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reply_4">
	<text>Ha! Ty jsi ale strazny. Teprve minuly rok te Mercenari honili po Temne udoli a ty jsi si strcil ocas mezi nohy. Nebo sis to zapomnel?</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b221_duty_reply_5">
	<text>Ano, dokazu si predstavit vysledky, ktere vedci dostavaji. Vzorky vzduchu: 100% kour, vzorky vody: 100% vodka a idioticky smich na vsech zvukovych frekvencich.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_duty_reply_6">
	<text>To je v poradku. Ziskame zpet nase zbrane. Vy jste si vyvinuli sikovny zvyk vyhazovat zbrane a artefakty pokazde, kdyz narazite na nase bojovniky. Nemam vam za to co vytknout. Nemuze to byt jednoduche, ze jo? S rozsekanymi kalhotami a vsim vsudy?</text>
</string>


<string id="jup_b221_freedom_main_1">
	<text>Kluci! Slyseli jste, jak Duty lpi na svych tradicich? Warrant Officer Morgan, aby zachoval povest sve frakce, se rozhodl prodat polovinu sveho skladu na miste. Myslel si, ze je to jeho 'povinnost'.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_main_2">
	<text>Sestavte se! Pametate? Stale tradice Duty byly stanoveny samotnym generalem Tkachenkem. Oklamal sve spolubojovniky, zavadel velitelstvi a statecne zemrel ve vesmirne bubline. At zije kazdy clen Duty, ktery jde jeho stopami.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_main_3">
	<text>Vite, kdyz jsem poprve videl nasi novou skupinu, zeptal jsem se jich: "Pratele, radeji byste se k nam v Duty pridali, ze ano? Muzete delat, co se vam libi." A vite co? Odpovedeli mi: "Ne, diky. S nimi jde vsechno jenom o rozkazech. Predevsim davat. Neni divu, ze maji prazdne oci. Mame uz dost zombii."</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_main_4">
	<text>Clen Duty pristoupil k jednomu z nasich lidi, vesel do bunkru a zeptal se ho: "Profesore, mohl byste mi rict, ktery artefakt je nejlepsi na boje s divocaky? Mechanicky klic, aby te chranil pred radiaci, nebo Oko, abys ti pomohlo s ranami." Vite, co byla odpoved? "Synku, to, co potrebujes, je Shell. Pokud uvidis divocaka, utec co nejrychleji zpatky do zakladny." Haha!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_main_5">
	<text>Lidi, vite, jak vedci vybrali nase kluky, aby merili anomalie? Ve skutecnosti sli nejprve za Shulgou a rekli mu: "Je tu prace, ktera je prospesna pro vedu." A on odpovedel: "Zadny problem. Koho mam popravit?"</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_main_6">
	<text>Den co den mi stale jasneji dochazi, jak moc potrebujeme Duty. Kdo by jiny slozil cely sklad zbrani a munice a pak hodaroval Freedom? Bylo to opravdu hezke z jejich strany, nemyslite?</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reaction_1">
<text>[smich]</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reaction_2">
<text>[smich]</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reaction_3">
<text>[smich]</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reaction_4">
<text>[smich]</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reply_1">
	<text>Ano? Vzpominam si, jak se tva odvazna skupina plazila na kolenou, prosic o pristup do Yanova pred emisi.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reply_2">
	<text>Kazdy ma sveho takoveho. Duty je opravdovym utocistem pokrytcu. "Budeme chranit svet pred Zonou", hned pote, co sezeneme par artefaktu.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reply_3">
	<text>Dobre, fanatik by mel zustat s fanatiky. Meli byste nosit i uniformy Monolitu. Aby se stalkerove snad nepletli az by vas videli, ze jste lidi.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reply_4">
	<text>Pred mutanti? Jste si jisti, ze budete mit dostatek mista v te sve bunkru, az se mutanti vrhnou v silne sile? Nejde o to jako v baru 100 Rads, kde se muzete jen tak zavrit a vyckat.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reply_5">
	<text>Pokud vasi dobrovolnici piji stejne jako vy, nemohu si predstavit, jake hodnoty ziskavaji vedci.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b221_freedom_reply_6">
	<text>Ano, tak je to spravne. Privedte co nejvic strazi. Ted uz o vasem skladu s vybavenim vi polovina Zony, takze ocekavejte navstevniky.</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b25_revage_senya">
	<text>Pockej...! Najdi ho! Nejhorsi jeste... arg...</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_artefact">
	<text>Mel bys mel videt, jak jsem nedavno ziskal tenhle artefakt. To bylo neco. Vis neco o Lomu? No, cokoli slusneho, co tam kdysi bylo, davno zmizelo. Nema smysl hledat v anomaliich, ktere prozkoumal Flint. To vi kazdy.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_bloodsucker">
	<text>Povim ti vsechno, co je treba vedet o krvavcich. Kdyz jsem byl v Zatonu, ti parchanti ztezovali zivot temer kazdemu. Stalkerove se na ne drzeli den a noc, ale nepomohlo to ani trochu. Chudaci. Jednoho dne jsem se rozhodl jim pomoci. Vzal jsem si svou brokovnici a rovnou zamiril do ukrytu krvavcu. Tri dny jsem si s temi parchanty uzival, casto jsem se pustil do dvou nebo dokonce tri najednou. Po kvalitnim case se mnou je problem s krvavci v Zatonu temer vyresen. Ti parchanti porad maji sve chapadla schovane.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_controller">
	<text>Dobre, povim ti, jak zabit kontrolery. Nedavno jsem narazil na hromadu artefaktu a rozhodl se je schovat, protoze uz mi zada nevydrzela. Na ceste zpet jsem dorazil ke svemu ukrytu a tam to bylo, kontroler, klidne sedel primo na vrchu. A ted jsem si rikal: "Kontroler nebo zadny kontroler, musim dostat zpatky svoje veci." Pak jsem si uvedomil, ze pokud se budu chranit necim, jeho manipulacni blaboly na me nebudou fungovat. Takze jsem vzal kus kovove mrize, kterou jsem nasel pobliz, a zacal se priblizit k oblude. Do te doby, nez si uvedomila, co se deje, jsem ji vystrelil cely zasobnik do hlavy. Prave kdyz se pokousela me ovladat, zasadil jsem ji posledni ranu pazbou od pusky a bylo hotovo.</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b25_story_first_reac_1">
<text>Aha! To je nejaky pribeh, Flinte.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_first_reac_2">
<text>Flint je opravdovy chlap, to je jiste.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_first_reac_3">
<text>Ano... Neni spatne.</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b25_story_guide">
	<text>No tak, jsem si jisty, ze vis o ceste ze Zatonu... Ne? No, pruvodce drive udelal obrovsky vylet. Co jsem udelal ja, bylo vytvorit zkratku primou linii, nova myslenka. Vyzkousel jsem par mist a rychle jsem nasel cestu pres anomalie. Takze jsem tuhle informaci prodal pruvodci a ted tudy vezme vsechny.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_oasis">
	<text>Slysel jsi o Oaze? Samozrejme jsi o ni slysel. Ja na druhou stranu jsem tam opravdu byl. Byl jsem prvni clovek, ktery objevil cestu tam, jakysi prukopnik. Tam neni zadne mutanti nebo proklate anomalie. Je to tiche jako hrbitov a plne artefaktu. Byl jsem tam jen pred par dny. V nedeli, vis to... Vest te tam? Ha! Omlouvam se, ale nechci tam tlacenici. Nic osobniho.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_scientist">
	<text>No, mam spoustu pribehu na vypraveni. Povidal jsem ti uz o tom, jak jsem pracoval pro vedce? Takze jednoho dne jsem zavital do jejich bunkru, zvedavy, co tam delaji. Nejprve byli vsichni v soku. Ale pak rekli: "Ty jsi presne to, co potrebujeme prave ted." Ukazalo se, ze chteli nastavit sva zarizeni pod anomaliemi. Samozrejme ti spratci si nechteli hrat s tim sami, tak mi slibili penize a dalsi veci. Takze jsem rekl: "No, to je v poradku, ale ty veci musi stat za to!" Musel jsem se plazit po te oblasti a hledat anomalie, ale nebylo to tak tezke jako dostat od tech blbecku penize za odmenu.</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_second_reac_1">
	<text>Fajn pribeh!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_second_reac_2">
	<text>Ano!</text>
</string>
<string id="jup_b25_story_second_reac_3">
	<text>O, wow!</text>
</string>

<string id="jup_b25_story_zaton">
	<text>Muze byt par lidi, kteri si mysli, ze Flint klame. No, muzou se zeptat kohokoli na zakladne o mne. Dokonce i tym profesionalnich lovcich, kdyz me videl nedavno, rikali vsichni: "Bez tebe to nezvladneme, Flinte. Nemuzeme to udelat bez tebe." Lovili chimeru, takze jsem musel temto "profikum" ukazat, jak se to dela. Moje munice je opravdu jednoducha. Jen se rovnou vrhnu do ukrytu. Zanechali tam jednoho novacka u vchodu, aby drzel oci na svestkach. Samozrejme, rano, jakmile ten novacek videl tu bestii, predral se ze slipu a utekl, takze jsem si musel s tim poradit sam. Uspesne, jak vidis, he-he-he...</text>
</string>

s: Pozor, stalkerove! Skadovsk je pod utokem! Museli jsme se uzavrit, dokud se situace neuklidni.
Attention stalkers, Skadovsk is under attack! We've been forced to batten down the hatches until things quiet down.
Poloz to zbran, kamo. Toto je nase taboriste, tady ji nepotrebujes.
Come on, man, put that shooter away. This is our camp, you don't need it here.
Hele, kamo, tady je to tak poklidne, jak jen to jde. Schovej svoji zbran a udrzme to tak.
Hey, man, this here place is as peaceful as it gets. So holster that shooter of yours and keep it that way.
Pozor, zbrane jsou k zabijeni mutantu a tady zadne nenajdes. Tak ji schovej, jo?
Look it, weapons are for killing mutants and you won't find any in here. So, put it away now, would you?
Pozor, stalkerove! Dvere do Skadovska jsou vam znovu otevreny.
Attention stalkers, the doors of Skadovsk are open to you once more.
Stalkeri, emise je konecne za nami. Doufam, ze jste v poradku.
Stalkers, the emission is finally over. I hope you're all in one piece.
Prijd, kdyz se objevi neco zajimaveho. Skadovsk tu zustane, to je jiste...
Drop in if something interesting comes up. Skadovsk won't be going anywhere, that's for sure...
Prijd, kdyz najdes artefakty, uvidime, co s nimi dokazeme udelat.
Drop in if you find any artefacts, and we'll see what we can do.
Uz jsme hotovi? ... Ano? Dobra... Vychod je tamhle.
Are we done here? ... Yes? Good... The exit is over there.
Jasne, jasne... Jdi uz. Starat se o pijavice neni na me priorite.
Yeah, yeah... You go on now. Dealing with leeches is not high on my list of priorities.
Ahoj! Co te sem privedlo na nasi skromnou lod?
Hello! What brings you to our humble vessel?
Lod je tu uz hodne dlouho, ale je to porad plne krys. K cemu vdecime za tuhle pochybnou radost?
The ship has been ashore a long time, but it's still full of rats. To what do we owe this dubious pleasure?
Pozor stalkri! Blizi se emise! Opakuji, blizi se emise! Okamzite se schovat!
Attention stalkers! An emission is approaching! I repeat, an emission is approaching! Seek cover immediately.
Pozor stalkri! Emise zacne v jakoukoli chvili. Najdete ukryt, pokud chcete zit!
Attention stalkers! An emission will start any minute now. Find cover if you want to live!
Dokumenty se odkazuji na centralni laborator oznacenou jako X8, ktera by mohla obsahovat informace o tajnych experimentech provadenych v Zone. Nasi analytici se touto otazkou jiz delsi dobu zabyvaji.

The documents refer to a central laboratory, designated X8, which yould contain information about secret experiments conducted in the Zone. Our analysts have been interested in this issue for quite some time.

Vypada to, ze posadka zemrela ve vzduchu a vrtulnik jednoduse havaroval, protoze nikdo ho neovladal. Palubni pocitac mel o trochu vetsi stesti. Zajimalo by me, jestli zde neni neco uzitecneho... Ah, tady je neco...! Mapa oblasti s oznacenymi urcitymi misty. To se muze hodit.

Looks like the crew died in mid-air, and the helicopter simply crashed because there was nobody there to fly it. The on-board computer was a little luckier. I wonder if there's anything useful here... Ah, there's something...! A map of the area, with certain locations marked. That should come in handy.
Elektronika je zde stejna, ale system ochrany pred emisemi je nedotceny. Co by to mohlo zpusobit?
The electronics are the same here, but the emission protection system is intact. What could've caused this?
Vsechna elektronika uvnitr vyhorela. Dokonce i plast napajeciho kabelu je roztaveny.
All the electronics inside burned out. Even the power cable sheathe is melted.
Tak, to je lepsi! Ted sem muzes prijit a promluvime si.
There, that's better! Now you can come on over, and we'll talk.
Rekl jsem ti, aby jsi schoval svoji zbran. Budu do tri pocitat a pokud to neudelas, rozdmycham ti hlavu!
I told you to put your shooter away. I'm going to count to three, and if you don't do it, I'll blow your freakin' head off!
Nemam chut placat jazykem. Mluv s velitelem!
I don't feel like beating gums. Talk to the commander!
Pokud se neco objevi, promluv s velitelem.
The commander is the one to speak to if something comes up.
Jsi blby nebo co? Ustup, nez ti vystrelim do mozku!
Are you dumb? Get back, before I blow your brains out!
Dobre, lidi, je cas se vratit. Jste k nicemu, takze neocekavejte odmenu.
All right, people, it's time to head back. You're useless, so don't expect a reward.
Mluv s bossem. Vic jsem pro strileni nez pro reci.
Talk to the boss. I'm more into shooting than beating gums.
Zeptal jsem se vsude, ale je to k nicemu. Nikdo nic nevi. Je to jako by byl poltergeist nebo neco podobneho.
I've asked everywhere, but it's useless. Nobody knows a thing. It's like he's a poltergeist or something.
Je hotovo. Nase prace je hotova, pojdme se vratit. Nezapomen zajit za Pastyrem do Janova a rict mu, ze zranena chimaera je porazena, abys dostal svoji cast.
It's over. Our job is done, let's head back. Remember to pop in to see Trapper at Yanov, and tell him the wounded chimera is done with to get your share.
Skvele odvedeno! Mozna by ses mel stat lovce chimer jako povolani.
Nicely done! You should look into hunting chimeras as a profession.
Jsme tam. Je to blizko, citim to. Kdyz ji uvidis, miri na hlavu. Ale nepriblizuj se moc, chimeri te citi na mili daleko, i kdyz spi.
We're there. It's close, I can sense it. If you see it, aim for the head. Don't get too close though, chimeras can smell you a mile off, even when they're sleeping.

Pozor! Chimera lovi v noci a rano se vraci do sveho ukrytu na odpocinek. Mohli bychom ji prekvapit pri svitani, kdyz odpociva. Staci se ji priblizit a zabit ji, dokud spi. Dost jednoduche. Ale musime vstavat brzy. Setkame se v baru v... 3 hodiny rano.

Listen now! The chimera hunts at night and returns to its lair in the morning for some beauty rest. We can catch it off-guard at dawn, when it's at rest. All we have to do is get close to it and kill it while it's still sleeping. Simple enough. We'll have to get up early though. Let's meet at the bar at... 3 in the morning.
Opatrne! Musime byt naprosto tisi, nesmi nas slyset.
Careful! We got to be real quiet, we can't let it hear us.
Ten parchant spi... Krab ti posila pozdrav. Hor!
The bastard is sleeping... Crab says hello. Fire!
Ten parchant syn beh nechape, ze toho bude litovat.
That son of a bitch is going to regret running away.
Tak, zjistil jsi neco o Magpie?
So, did you find anything out about Magpie?
Drz se tam, kamarade, doktor rekl, ze budes za par dni zase na nohou. Mohl bys vyuzit tenhle cas k odpocinku a relaxaci.
Hang in there, buddy, the doc said you'll be up on your feet in a couple of days. You might as well use this time to rest up and chill.
Hej stalkre! Pojd sem! Mam pro tebe otazku.
Hey stalker! Come here! I got a question for you.
Dobre! Ted se otoc pomalu a uz se ztrat zpatky tam, odkud jsi prisel!
Good! Now turn around, slowly, and piss off back to where you came from!
Are you dumb or something? Get outta here!
Hej, hovado! Je tam vubec nekdo? Miz, nebo te sem a ted rozsekam!
Hey, douchebag! Is anyone even there? Scram, or I'll drop you right friggin now!
I'm going to bleed you dry, asshole!
Zustan tam stat a ani nemysli na to, abys se hnul, ty hovado! Jedno spatne pohybu a jsi k nicemu!
Stay still and don't even think about moving, asshole! One wrong move and you're toast!
Zastav tam! Schovaj zbran a nehni se!
Stop right there! Holster your weapon, and don't you move!
Hej, Vouse, podivej, co jsem nasel na te stare trosce! Tohle bude stacit?
Hey, Beard, check out what I found on that old tub! Will this do?
Wow, to je neco uplne jineho...! Nikdy jsem takovou vec nevidel. Tady, vem si tohle.
Wow, that's something else...! I've never seen one of these before. Here, take this.
Dekuji. Pokud mate jeste nejakou praci, vite, kde me najdete.
Thank you. If you have any more work, you know where to find me.
Jen se bezte dal. Urcite si na tenhle okamzik vzpomenete.
Just do keep walking. You'll remember this moment, that's for sure.
Ach, jsi to ty... No, penize potrebuji stejne jako ty.
Oh it's you... Well, I need cash as much as you do.
Aah... Tohle je to! Je to konec! Jsou tu... mutanti... vsude mutanti!
Aah... This is it! This is the end! It's here... Mutants... mutants everywhere!
Tahle hovadina te nezachrani, az ti mutanti zacnou lezou ze vsech koutu. Tady, vezmi si to a zmiz mi z oci!
This crap won't save you when the muties crawl out of the woodwork. Here, take this and get out of my face!
Ha! Myslis si, ze te to ochrani pred emisi? Tady, vezmi si to a utec. Zachran si zadek!
Ha! You think that will protect you from a emission? Here, take this and run. Save your skin!
Vypadnete odsud, parchanti, nebo vas vsechny sestrelim!
Get out of here you bastards, or I'll take you all out!
Skvela prace! Klidne se nekdy stav.
Nice job! Feel free to drop by sometime.
Takze tam jsou ti proklati mutanti. Vylezli na plosinu s tim, ze si mysli, ze je Noah nedostane. Asi nevi, ze mam vlastni cestu tam nahoru od severni farmy. Ceka te zabavna jizda, parchanti!

So that's where those damn mutants are. They climbed up to the plateau, thinking that Noah won't get to them. I guess they don't know that I've got a personal path up there by the northern farmstead. You're in for a fun ride, assholes!

Zaznam 12. Moje vyzkum se brzy uzavre... Lide v tabore zacinaji neco tusit. Grouse s Danilou planuji jit lovit nejake vysavace krve... Zajimalo by me, kdy si toho vsimnou? Musim seradit sklenice s krvi, abych zjistil, ktere jsou kontaminovane... A zbytek schovat... Nekdo jde... Zaznam 13. Mozna muj posledni. Nejprve ten zvedavy lovec a ted jeste Grouse. S timto neutecu. Prijdou pro me. Vim to... Ale vlastne je to jedno... Tato zavislost na hemoglobinu me brzy zabije. Radeji zemru od kulky nez na nemoc.

Recording 12. My research will be over soon... People at the camp are starting to suspect something. Grouse and Danila are planning to hunt some bloodsuckers... I wonder when they'll figure it out? I need to sort the jars of blood to find out which ones have been contaminated... And hide the rest... Someone's coming. ... Recording 13. Possibly my last. First that nosey hunter, and now Grouse. I won't get away with this. They'll come for me. I know it. ... Doesn't really matter. ... This hemoglobin dependency will kill me soon anyway. And I'd rather die from a bullet than a disease.
Co se deje? Jsi zraneny nebo trpis radiaci?
What's up? You wounded, or suffering from radiation sickness?
Vedel jsem, ze se nakonec prozradim... Jsem si jisty, ze mas spoustu otazek.
I knew I'd be exposed eventually. ... I'm sure you have many questions.
Informace na palubnim pocitaci... Dobra, Stingray-3 mel poruchu obou motoru. Hm... Co jeste?... Mapa s moznymi evakuacnimi misty. Pozice B2, B28 a B205. Zajimave.

Information on the on-board computer... Okay, so Stingray-3 had engine failure in both engines. Hmm... What else is there?... A map with what look like possible evacuation locations. Positions B2, B28 and B205. Interesting.
Prace je hotova. Tady je artefakt.
The job is done. Here's the artefact.
Prace je hotova. Tady, vezmi si ten artefakt.
Job's done. Here, take the artefact.
It's over there... Help yourself to a drink!
What... What can I do you for?...
Aah... Eh, it's you... Come in!
Co? Se... Sedesat dva...? To je nemozne.
...I'm telling you, there's not enough juice...
Hej, kluci, kam jdete...? Ne, ja... Ja tu zustanu...
Hey, guys, where are you going...? Nah, I'll... I'll stay here...
Here's to a good day's work!
Tohle je Sovicka. Prijd za mnou! Musime si promluvit o nasem obchode.
This is Owl. Come see me! We need to talk about our business.
That's right, get on outta here!
Don't let the door hit you...
Co jsi, socha? Pokud mas neco, rekni to. Pokud ne, slapej pryc!
What are you, a statue? If you got something, spill the beans. If not, take a hike!
Wow, to je pekna zbran! Dej mi na ni kuk.
Wow, that's a nice shooter! Let me have a look at it.
Videl jsem, jak se do budovy dostal krevsajr. Predpokladam, ze tam maji sve utociste... Ale pojdme tu teorii otestovat.
I saw a bloodsucker enter the building. I'm guessing that's their lair... But let's put that theory to the test.
Slysel jsi to? ... Nechte toho, asi jsem to slysel jenom ja.
Did you hear that? ... Nevermind, I must be hearing things.
Pssst! Jsou tady spici krevsaugri. Pokusme se jimi projit beze zvuku.
Shh! It's full of sleeping bloodsuckers. Let's try to get by them without making any noise.
Pojd sem, podivej se na to! ... Je to asi jedina cesta do sklepa.
Come, look at this! ... It's probably the only way of getting into the basement.
Prosim, zdrz svuj potlesk! Ted se podivame dovnitr.
Please, hold your applause! Now, let's take a look inside.
Mas nozicky stale v poradku? Zkontrolujme ten sklep.
Your footsies still intact? Let's check out this basement then.
Pfiu... zvladli jsme to. A jeste jsme je neprobudili ze spanku.
Phew... we made it. And didn't even disturb their nap time.
Myslim, ze jsem nasel ukryt. Prijed sem co nejdriv!
I think I found the lair. Get over here, ASAP!
Co do haje delas? Strelil jsi me!
What the hell are you doing? You shot me!
No, skok dolu je jedina moznost... Jdi za mnou!
Well, jumping down is the only way... Follow me!
This looks like an exit! Jump!
Jeden je pryc! Ale byli tu dva, tak bud opatrny!
One down! But there were two of them, so watch out!
To by melo stacit. To byl posledni.
That should be it. That was the last one.
Tady neni zadny lovec... Jezis! Podivej se, jsou to drapy. Ti kluci, ktere jsme nasli predtim, nemeli drapy. Divne.
Podivej se na ty drapy! Zvlastni...
Look at the claw marks! Strange...
Ti tela, ktere jsme predtim nasli, je nemela.
The bodies we found before didn't have those.
The hunter isn't here, let's go!
Davej pozor na stiny! Mohou se objevit odkudkoli.
Watch the shadows! They can appear from anywhere.
Lovec se nam nepodarilo najit, ale mam predstavu, kde by mohl byt. Necham to zkontrolovat a pak se ti ozvu. Mezitim dej vedet stalkerum o techto krvave sajicich bestiich

We didn't find the hunter, but I have an idea where he might be. Let me check it out, then I'll contact you. While I do that, let the stalkers know about these blood-sucking assholes. Something needs to be done about them.
Musime o tom informovat Bearda. Doufejme, ze vi, jak se s temi parchanty vyporadat.
We need to tell Beard about this. Let's hope he'll know how to deal with these bastards
Tohle je moje prace. Zamky jsem odemykal cely zivot.
This is what I do. I've been picking locks all my life.

Jsem si jisty, ze artefakt je na samotnem strome. Je zrejme, ze se mohu vylezt na strom z kopce. Jen doufam, ze na tech kopcich nejsou mutanti. Je skoda, ze jsem sem musel prijit sam pote, co jsem mel hadku s Cardanem a Barge. Ale az prinesu ten artefakt zpet, uvidi, ze jsem mel porad pravdu.

I'm positive the artefact is on the tree itself. It's clear from here that I can climb onto the tree from the hill. I just hope the hills are free of mutants. It's too bad I had to come here on my own after that argument with Cardan and Barge. But when I bring back the artefact, they'll see I was right all along.
Vrat se, stopari! Toto misto neni pro tebe!
Turn back, stalker! This place ain't for you!
Stopari! Uz se zde nechapej, dokud jeste mas nohy!
Stalker! Off with you, while you still got legs!
Go, get out of here while you can!

Cardan, ten stary opilec! Nejenze je liny parchant, jakmile se napil, "Je tady lip. Meli bychom si to uzit..." Ale pak na me a Jokera zautoci, rika, ze jsme mladi a nemame paru! Haha...! Aha, Joker je taky kus prace. Nabere, ze se napil, popadne tasku a zmizi. Kdyz jsem se snazil uklidnit Cardana, odesel a sakra nevim, kam sel. A co mam delat ja? Pit s tim senilnim blbcem? Ne, dekuji, jeho vodka je odporna! Fuj. A pomyslet si, jak slibne to vsechno zacalo...

Cardan, that old drunk! Not only is he a lazy bastard once he's had a drink, 'It's better here. We need to take it easy...' But then he goes and takes a rant at me and Joker, saying we're young and ain't got a clue! Haha...! Eh, Joker's a piece of work too. Gets pissed up, grabs his bag and disappears. While I was trying to calm Cardan down, he left and hell if I know where he went. And what am I supposed to do? Drink with that senile moron? No, thank you, his vodka is shit! Eww. And to think how promising things were at the beginning...
Podivej, mame tady tyhle artefakty a muzeme jich ziskat vic. Vymenou hledame zbrane a dobre vybaveni.
Look, we've got these here artefacts, and we can get more of them. In exchange, we're looking for weapons, and some good equipment.
Ty, idiote, privedl jsi toho spiona s sebou!
You, idiot, brought that tail with you!
What have you got, show me!
Vis, ze mam cokoli, co ma Odpad, takze zbrane a vybaveni nejsou problem. Vsechno, co mam, je prvotridni, o tom neni pochyb.
You know that I've got whatever Duty's got, so weapons and equipment are not a problem. All my stuff is top quality, no doubt about it.
Execute them. I don't need witnesses.
Pockame tady. Klienti by se meli brzy objevit.
We'll wait here. The clients should show up soon.
Proc si nedame maly rozhovor, ty a ja?
Why don't we have a little chat, you and I?
No, to objasnuje veci. Sraz je!
Well, that clears things up. Take them down!
Davej pozor, at te hlidka nevidi.
Don't let the sentry see you.
Dobre. Ted se vypadni odtud, nez si rozmyslim!
Good. Now get the hell out of here, before I change my mind!
Stale tady? Nejsem trpelivy clovek, vis?
You're still here? I'm not a patient man you know...
Dobre, dost bylo! Srazim te dolu!
Okay, that's it! You're going down!
Kluci, nechce spolupracovat. Zbavte se ho!
Bros, he doesn't want to cooperate. Drop him!
Kluci, tenhle parchant se nechce podelit!
Bros, this asshole doesn't want to share!
To je ten chlapek s tou peknou zbrani! Hej, pockej!
That's that dude with the nice shooter! Hey, wait up!
Jen se uvolni a pokracuj v pohybu.
Vidis, tvuj oblek to zvladne. Pokracuj dal!
See, your suit can handle it. Keep going!
Uvidime se... Pokud se ti podari zustat cely.
See you... If you manage to stay in one piece, that is.
Zastav se nekdy. Uzijeme si spoustu zabavy!
Drop by some time. We'll have a good time!
Takze jsi dokazal dostat sem svou zadnici? Bravo!
So, you managed to drag your ass over here? Bravo!
No, to je hotovo. ... Co sakra delas? Obdivujes okolni krajinu?
Well, that's that. ... What the hell were you doing? Admiring the scenery?
Tak, to je hotovo! Bylo sladke te sledovat pri praci.
Well, that's that! It was sweet watching you work.
Zklidni se, chlapce! Zvladneme je s lehkosti.
Take a chill pill, man! We'll take them easy.
Takze... Uz jsme na tebe dlouho cekali.
So...! We've been waiting for you a long time now.
Co sakra...?! Schovavaji se nebo co?
What the...?! Did they hide, or something?
Listen up! Sultan wants to see you.
Dostali jsme ty parchanty. Nejsi moc ochotny zapojit se do opravdoveho boje, ze?
We got the bastards. You're not keen to get involved in a real fight, are you?
Dostali jsme ty parchanty. Diky za tvoji pomoc!
We got the bastards. Thanks for your help!
Podivejte se na toho! Sam muz!
Would you look at that! The man himself!
Schovej tu zbran, tulaku, nebo te rovnou zahrabu do zeme!
Holster that shooter, stalker, or I'm putting you right in the ground!
Co mam delat? Kdyz tam pujdu, prijdu o penize. Kdyz tam nepujdu, skoncim mrtvy.
What do I do? If I go, I'll lose money. If I don't go, I'll end up dead.
Proc... slysim tam stale triskani drobnych v tvych kapsach?... No, slysim?
Why... Is that change I still hear chingiling in your pockets?... Well, is it?
Jeden dalsi krok a je mrtvy!
One more step, and he's dead!
Hej! Co tu delas? Vrat se tam, odkud jsi prisel, dokud jeste mas nohy.
Hey! What are you doing here? Go back to where you came from while you still got legs.
Stale si myslim, ze bychom meli prodat artefakt a pouzit penize na najmuti lidi. Timto zpusobem muzeme spolecne zautocit na bandity.
I still think that we should sell the artefact and use the money to recruit people. This way we can attack the bandits together.
Nemyslis, ze ho hned zastreli, jakmile budou mit artefakt?
You don't think they'll shoot him as soon as they have the artefact?
Nemuzeme se jim podvolit. Bez ohledu na to, co jim date, vzdy chteji vic.
We can't give in to them. No matter what you give them, they always want more.
To v zadnem pripade! Mnohem lepe je, kdyz jim dame artefakt jako vykupne.
No way! We're much better off giving them the artefact as ransom.
Jiste ho zastreli, kdyz zacneme strilet.
They'll definitely shoot him if we come out blasting.
Neustoupime...! Dodrzovani jejich podminek je jedina moznost, kterou mame.
We're not giving in...! Complying with their conditions is the only option we have.
Run! We can still make it!
Hej, kam jdes? Pockej! Vrat se sem zpatky!
Hey, where are you going? Wait! Come back here!
Setkam se s tebou u stareho nadrazi.
I'll meet you by the old train station.
Pozor vsichni stalkerove a kdokoli dalsi, kdo se stara, stanice Yanov byla napadena! Prozatim jsme zablokovali vsechny vstupy.
Attention all stalkers and anyone else who cares, Yanov station has been attacked! We've blocked all the entrances for the time being.
Schovej tu zbran. Toto je neutralni oblast.
Put that gun away. This is a neutral area.
Jsme uz tak v ohnisku palby, stalkeru. Pokud neuchovas tu zbran, zadas si problemy.
We're in the firing line as it is, stalker. If you don't put that weapon away, you're asking for trouble.
Dokud mas zbran v ruce, nedostanes se dal. Rozumel si?!
So long as there's a gun in your hand, you ain't gettin' in. You got that?!
Zpomal, sefe. Nejprve schovej tu zbran.
Slow down, chief. Put that shooter away first.
Stalkere, pokud chces vejit, pripoutej svoji zbran.
Stalker, if you want to enter, holster your weapon.
Pozor vsichni stalkerove a kdokoli dalsi, kdo se stara, Yanov je opet bezpecny. Jste vitani kdykoliv.
Attention all stalkers and anyone else who cares, Yanov is secure again. You're welcome to visit anytime.
See you again some time, stalker!
Tak to je ode me. Mej se fajn!
Okay, that's us. Have a good one!
Pojd dal, kamo, uvolni se. Sbal se a odpocin si.
Come on in, man, relax. Take your load off.
Zastav se nekdy. Tady to muze byt zabava.
Pop in some time. It can be fun around here.
Pojd sem, kamo! Mam vsechno, co budes kdy potrebovat.
Come on over, bro! I've got all the shit you're ever gonna need.
Emitovani je za nami. Doufam, ze je vsichni v poradku. Pokud jsi zraneny, prijd do Yanova a vylecime te.
The emission is over. I hope everyone's okay. If you're hurt, come to Yanov and we'll patch you up.
Dalsi! ... eh... Mej se hezky a bud zdravy!
Next! ...er... I mean... take care and stay healthy!
Dbej na sebe a vyhybej se problemum!
Jsi bledy, kamo. Co takhle par injekci?
You're a touch pale, buddy. How about a little injection or two?
Znovu zraneny? Neztracis cas, ze ne?
Wounded again? You don't waste any time, do you.
Pozor, pozor! Priblizuje se emitovani. Okamzite najdi kryt!
Attention, attention! An emission is approaching. Find cover immediately!
Pozor, pozor! Emitovani je na ceste! Okamzite najdi kryt!
Attention, attention! An emission is about to hit! Find cover immediately!
Takze... Prechod podzemim byl naplnen plynem pote, co byl uzavren.
So... The underpass was filled with gas after it was sealed.
Vstup do podzemniho tunelu je tady. Pokud aktivujeme generator, budeme schopni odemknout prepravni zamek.
The entrance to the underpass is here. If we activate the generator, we'll be able to open the transportation lock.
Schema pro podzemni tunel "Pripyat-1". To je dukaz, ze existuje podzemni cesta do Pripyatu.
Schematics for the 'Pripyat-1' underpass. This is proof that there is an underground way to get to Pripyat.
Hele, kamo! Cas je penize. Uz jsme na tebe necekali, skupina uz se vraci.
Hey, man! Time is money. We're done waiting for you, the squad is going back now.
Wat... watch... watch out, contro... control... controller!
Uhm... sakra... co... co se deje...? Zase...
Uhm... holy... what... what is...? What... again...
Ooh... impuls... ...bleh... hrozne...! Kamo, hlava me rozdira!
Ooh... impulse... ...bleh... terrible...! Man, my head is killing me!
Budeme tu na tebe cekat. Kdyby se neco stalo, mas nas za zady.
We'll wait for you here. If anything happens, we got your back.
Ach, sakra! Radsi se rychle vyparme odsud!
Oh, crap! We've better get out of here, pronto!
Tak ty jsi expert na diru, co? He-he-he... Nemej strach, kluci se postaraji o mutanty rychle a efektivne.
So you're the hole expert, eh? He-he-he... Don't worry, you can count on the boys to take the muties out, nice and quick.
Hmm... vypada to tady klidne. Muzeme pokracovat.
Hmm... it looks quiet. We can advance.
Je to v pohode. Bylo tam par potkanu, ale zpracovali jsme je.
It's all good. There were a few hamsters in there, but we dealt with them.
Vypada to, ze to bylo posledni z nich.
Look like that was the last of them.
Aargh... Je ve mne! Ne... neee...
Ahoj, tady Nitro. Za to pametove moduly se stav. Je pro tebe pripraveny.
Hiya, it's Nitro. Swing by for that memory module. It's ready for you.
Ok, je to dohoda: pujdeme spolecne. Jakekoliv bojovniky, ktere uvidis, mi posli a ja z nich udelam tym. Az bude vsechno pripravene, dej mi vedet. Sebereme Nitra a vydame se na Jupiter.
Ok, it's a deal: we'll go together. Whatever fighters you see, send them my way and I'll make a team out of them. Once everything is ready, give me a shout. We'll pick up Nitro and head for Jupiter.
Vypada to jako klidna vesnice... pokud neporusime mistni obyvatele.
Looks like a quiet village... unless we disturb the local residents.
Tak klidne, jako bychom byli na letovisku.
So peaceful, it's like a resort.
Get up here, things are about to kick off!
No tak, na co cekas? Zmeskas tu nejlepsi cast.
Come on, what are you waiting for? You'll miss the best part.
Co delas? Pospichej, zacina ta zabava.
What are you doing? Hurry up, the fun stuff is about to start.
Takze, to je vse. Vidim, ze se te to hemzi otazkami, a chapu to. Pojdme si pokecat, co ty na to?
So, that's that. I can see you're bursting with questions, and I can understand that. Let's have a little talk, shall we?
Vypada to, ze jsem mel pravdu. Ted nas budou zombie kryt, strilej ty parchanty!
Looks like I was right after all. Now the zombies are gonna cover us, shoot those bastards down!
Vypada to, ze jsem mel pravdu. Strilej ty parchanty!
Looks like I was right after all. Shoot those bastards down!
Let's see if I was right.
Proc jsi to udelal? Nedotkl se te, ze ne. Zatracene!
What did you do that for? He didn't touch you, did he. Damn!
Sultane, s tim luzrem jsem si poradil poradne. To ho nauci, at se s nami neplete.
Sultan, I've dealt with that loser real good. That will teach him not to mess with us.
Sultan posila pozdravy. Otevri si pusu, parchante!
Sultan sends his regards. Open wide, punk!

Musim se dostat dal od techhle prcku, cim driv, tim lip. Korist, kterou jsem schoval za podstavcem, mi vydrzi na chvili. Je cas jit dal. Urcite uz me hledaji. Ale to je fuk. Uvidime, kdo koho dostane nakonec.

I got to get away from these assholes, the sooner the better. The loot I've stashed behind the substation should last me a while. It's time to move on. I'm sure they are already looking for me. It's all right tho. We'll see who gets who in the end.
Hej! Odsud zmiz! Jen clenove Duty maji vstup.
Hey! Get out of here! Duty members only.
Gavrilenko! Zjistil jsem o tom skladu. Jsou to Freedomovci a je jich tam hodne. Seber celou svoji jednotku a ty parchante rychle seridime.
Gavrilenko! I found out about the warehouse. It's Freedom, and there should be lots of them. Bring your whole squad and we'll deal those punks real fast.
Pokud tohle projde, dostanes pristup ke skladu.
If this checks out, you'll get access to the warehouse.
Pozor, Freedomovci! Tohle je uzemi Duty. Vypadnete odtud od toho skladu!
Attention, Freedom! This is Duty territory. Get the hell away from the warehouse!
Zatraceni...! Sami si za to muzou. Chlapi, zacnete s operaci!
Bastards...! Well, they asked for it. Men, commence with the operation!
Tohle neni verejna cast, kloucku. Nejlepsi by bylo, kdybys sel svou cestou.
This ain't no public part, boy. You'd best be on your way.
Kremen! Vezmi sve lidi a pripoj se k Haidukovi u skladu. Ty Duty parchanti by se meli brzy objevit pro svoje veci.
Kremen! Take your men and join Haiduk at the warehouse. Those Duty bastards should come for their stuff any minute now.
Skvele! Ted se kluci dokazou branit. Nestanu na laskavosti, takze muzes tu schranku pouzit kdykoli budes chtit. Dam vsem vedet.
Great! Now the boys will be able to fight them off. I don't forget favours, so you can use the stash anytime you want. I'll let everyone know.
Jasne! Jen nam dej chvili na to, abychom si doplnili nejake strelivo.
Sure thing! Just give us a minute to stock up on some ammo.
Hele, tady Trapper. Mel jsem tady lovce, ktery videl vcera vecer chimeru. Podle popisu je to ta sama, kterou hledame. Prijd se mnou, pokud muzes. Je to dulezite.
Hey, it's Trapper. I just had a hunter here who saw a chimera last night. Judging by the description it's the same one we're after. Come, see me if you can. It's important.
Tady jsme. Stanice Yanov je utocistem relativni bezpecnosti v okoli Jupiteru. Tady se rozchazime kazdy svou cestou. Ale pokud me budes potrebovat, hledej me v baru.
Here we are. Yanov station is a haven of relative safety in the area around Jupiter. This is where we go on our separate ways. But if you need me, look for me by the bar.

Jsi tu poprve? Ja jsem tu relativne novy. Jmenuju se Nitro a zabyvam se vybavenim. Opravim cokoli, co potrebujes. Ale... sehnat dobre naradi je tady problem. Pokud neco uvidis, prineste to rovnou ke mne. A pokud potrebujes technickou pomoc, prijd za mnou a rad udelam, co budu moci pro tebe udelat.

First time here? I'm relatively new here myself. The name's Nitro. I work with equipment. I can repair anything you need. But... getting some good tools is a problem around here. If you see anything, bring it straight to me. And if you need any technical help, come see me, and I'll be glad to do what I can for you.
I have a bad feeling about this.
Tak to je! To je lepsi.
No, navrhuji pripit na statecny tym muzu Duty, kteri byli poslani na predni linie, aby poradne zmlatili zeleny hnoj.
Well, I propose a toast to a brave squad of Duty men, sent to the front lines for some serious green scum ass kicking.

Rekl jsem vam nekdy pribeh o Flintovi? Nejprve nastavil stalkerum past s chimerou, aby je napadla, potom nechal sveho partnera zemrit v anomalii a nakonec se pridal k Freedomu. Rekl bych, ze to je docela logicky zaver. Takze pripijime na nadeji, ze vsichni clenove Freedomu pujdou jeho cestou a my se postarame o ty, kdo zbyli.

Have I told you the story about Flint? First he set up stalker hunters to get attacked by a chimera, then he left his partner to die in an anomaly and then he joined Freedom. I'd say that's a pretty logical conclusion right there. So, I'd say we drink to the hope that all members of Freedom follow his lead and we'll take care of whoever is left.
Pijme na to, ze i v centru Zony jsou lide ochotni slouzit Dutu. Na nasi nove skupinu!
Let's drink to the fact that even in the center of the Zone there are people who are willing to serve Duty. To our new squad!
Zdvihuji sklenici na to, ze tento vyzkumny komplex je nyni plne chranen Dutou pred mutanti, anarchisty a dalsimi nizsimi tvory.
I raise my glass to the fact that this research complex is now fully protected by Duty from mutants, anarchists and other scum.
Kamaradi! Vypijme to na pocest nasich statecnych dobrovolniku, kteri provadeji mereni v nejnebezpecnejsich oblastech Zony pro nas vedecky pokrok.
Fellows! Let's drink to honour our brave volunteers for taking readings in some of the Zone's most dangerous areas for the good of our scientific progress.
Navrhuji pripitek pro bojovniky Duty, kteri statecne odrazili zbabely utok tech odpornych parchantu.
I propose a toast to Duty fighters who courageously fought off a cowardly attack made by those filthy punks.
Uz je mrtvy. A kdyby to bylo na mne, nechal bych vsechny vas nasledovat. Naucil bych vas prestat vyvazet vyrobky Zony zahnanim tou samou chamtivosti.
He's dead already. And if it were up to me I'd have all of you follow suit. Teach you to quit exporting the Zone's products outside driven by that same greed.
Nikdo nevi, co se skutecne stalo. Nebyl jsi tam, abys to videl.
Nobody knows what really happened. It's not like you were there to see it.
Je to skupina slozena z lidi z Monolitu? No, doufam, ze si take najdete skupinu krevsajru, protoze az to udelate, podplukovnik vas urcite prida na seznam nebezpecnych mutantu.

Is that a squad made up of Monolith people? Well, I hope you'll find yourself a bloodsucker squad too, 'cause once you do, the Lieutenant Colonel will definitely add you to the list of dangerous mutants.
Ha! Ty jsi ale strazny. Teprve minuly rok te Mercenari honili po Temne udoli a ty jsi si strcil ocas mezi nohy. Nebo sis to zapomnel?
Ha! Some guard you are. Just last year the Mercenaries had you running around the Dark Valley with your tail between your legs. Or have you forgotten?
Ano, dokazu si predstavit vysledky, ktere vedci dostavaji. Vzorky vzduchu: 100% kour, vzorky vody: 100% vodka a idioticky smich na vsech zvukovych frekvencich.
Yes, I can imagine the readings the scientists are getting. Air samples: 100% smoke, water samples: 100% vodka, and idiotic laughter on all sound frequencies.

To je v poradku. Ziskame zpet nase zbrane. Vy jste si vyvinuli sikovny zvyk vyhazovat zbrane a artefakty pokazde, kdyz narazite na nase bojovniky. Nemam vam za to co vytknout. Nemuze to byt jednoduche, ze jo? S rozsekanymi kalhotami a vsim vsudy?

That's all right. We'll get our weapons back. You guys have developed a nifty habit of dropping weapons and artefacts whenever you run into our fighters. I don't blame you either. Can't be easy holding at it, what, with your pants shat and all?
Kluci! Slyseli jste, jak Duty lpi na svych tradicich? Warrant Officer Morgan, aby zachoval povest sve frakce, se rozhodl prodat polovinu sveho skladu na miste. Myslel si, ze je to jeho 'povinnost'.

Boys! Have you heard how Duty is sticking to its traditions? Take Warrant Officer Morgan, in following the strict need to maintain his faction's reputation he thought it was his 'duty' to sell off half his warehouse on the sight.

Sestavte se! Pametate? Stale tradice Duty byly stanoveny samotnym generalem Tkachenkem. Oklamal sve spolubojovniky, zavadel velitelstvi a statecne zemrel ve vesmirne bubline. At zije kazdy clen Duty, ktery jde jeho stopami.

Fall in! Remember? Duty's stalwart traditions were laid down by General Tkachenko himself. He lied to his comrades, misled the HQ and bravely died in a Space Bubble. Here's to all members of Duty following his lead.

Vite, kdyz jsem poprve videl nasi novou skupinu, zeptal jsem se jich: "Pratele, radeji byste se k nam v Duty pridali, ze ano? Muzete delat, co se vam libi." A vite co? Odpovedeli mi: "Ne, diky. S nimi jde vsechno jenom o rozkazech. Predevsim davat. Neni divu, ze maji prazdne oci. Mame uz dost zombii."

You know, the first time I saw our new squad I asked them, 'Fellows, would you prefer to join Duty instead? You're free to do as you like, after all.' You know, they said to me, 'No, thank you. With them, it's all about the orders. To give, primarily. No wonder their eyes are empty. We've had enough of zombies.'

Clen Duty pristoupil k jednomu z nasich lidi, vesel do bunkru a zeptal se ho: "Profesore, mohl byste mi rict, ktery artefakt je nejlepsi na boje s divocaky? Mechanicky klic, aby te chranil pred radiaci, nebo Oko, abys ti pomohlo s ranami." Vite, co byla odpoved? "Synku, to, co potrebujes, je Shell. Pokud uvidis divocaka, utec co nejrychleji zpatky do zakladny." Haha!

A member of Duty came up to one of our people, got in the bunker and asked him, 'Professor, could you tell me which artefact is best for fighting boars? Wrenched to protect you from radiation, or Eye to help you with wounds.' Do you know what the answer was? 'Shell is what you need, son. If you see a boar, run back to your base as fast as you can.' Haha!

Lidi, vite, jak vedci vybrali nase kluky, aby merili anomalie? Ve skutecnosti sli nejprve za Shulgou a rekli mu: "Je tu prace, ktera je prospesna pro vedu." A on odpovedel: "Zadny problem. Koho mam popravit?"

People, you know how the scientists came to choose our boys to take anomaly measurements? They actually went to see Shulga first and said to him, 'There's a job that needs doing for the benefit of science.' And he said, 'No problem. Who do I have to execute?'
Den co den mi stale jasneji dochazi, jak moc potrebujeme Duty. Kdo by jiny slozil cely sklad zbrani a munice a pak hodaroval Freedom? Bylo to opravdu hezke z jejich strany, nemyslite?

With every day that goes by the need for Duty becomes clearer to me. I mean, who else would put together a whole warehouse of weapons and ammo, and then donate it to Freedom? It was really nice of them, wouldn't you say?
Ano? Vzpominam si, jak se tva odvazna skupina plazila na kolenou, prosic o pristup do Yanova pred emisi.
Yeah? Well, I seem to remember how your brave squad was on their knees groveling for access to Yanov before an emission.
Kazdy ma sveho takoveho. Duty je opravdovym utocistem pokrytcu. "Budeme chranit svet pred Zonou", hned pote, co sezeneme par artefaktu.
Everyone's got one of those. Duty is a real haven for hypocrites. 'We'll protect the world from the Zone', right after we collect a few artefacts.
Dobre, fanatik by mel zustat s fanatiky. Meli byste nosit i uniformy Monolitu. Aby se stalkerove snad nepletli az by vas videli, ze jste lidi.
Good deal. Fanatic should stick with fanatics. You should wear Monolith uniforms too. Lest stalkers might actually confuse you for humans.
Pred mutanti? Jste si jisti, ze budete mit dostatek mista v te sve bunkru, az se mutanti vrhnou v silne sile? Nejde o to jako v baru 100 Rads, kde se muzete jen tak zavrit a vyckat.
From mutants? You sure you'll have enough space in that bunker when the mutants come out in force? It's not like it's the 100 Rads bar. You can't just hole up there and wait it out.
Pokud vasi dobrovolnici piji stejne jako vy, nemohu si predstavit, jake hodnoty ziskavaji vedci.
If your volunteers drink as much as you do, I can only imagine the readings scientists are getting.
Ano, tak je to spravne. Privedte co nejvic strazi. Ted uz o vasem skladu s vybavenim vi polovina Zony, takze ocekavejte navstevniky.
Yeah, that's right. Bring in as many guards as you can. Now half the Zone knows about your equipment warehouse, so expect visitors.
Pockej...! Najdi ho! Nejhorsi jeste... arg...
Hold on...! Find him! Worst is yet... argh...

Mel bys mel videt, jak jsem nedavno ziskal tenhle artefakt. To bylo neco. Vis neco o Lomu? No, cokoli slusneho, co tam kdysi bylo, davno zmizelo. Nema smysl hledat v anomaliich, ktere prozkoumal Flint. To vi kazdy.

You should have seen me getting this one artefact the other day. That was something. You know anything about the Quarry? Well. Whatever decent shit there once was is long gone. There's no point looking in anomalies Flint has looked in. Everyone knows that.

Povim ti vsechno, co je treba vedet o krvavcich. Kdyz jsem byl v Zatonu, ti parchanti ztezovali zivot temer kazdemu. Stalkerove se na ne drzeli den a noc, ale nepomohlo to ani trochu. Chudaci. Jednoho dne jsem se rozhodl jim pomoci. Vzal jsem si svou brokovnici a rovnou zamiril do ukrytu krvavcu. Tri dny jsem si s temi parchanty uzival, casto jsem se pustil do dvou nebo dokonce tri najednou. Po kvalitnim case se mnou je problem s krvavci v Zatonu temer vyresen. Ti parchanti porad maji sve chapadla schovane.

I'll tell you everything there is to say about bloodsuckers. When I was at Zaton, those assholes made life real difficult for just about everyone. Stalkers kept at 'em day and night but it didn't help one bit. Poor bastards. One day I decided to help them out. So I took my shotgun and went straight for the bloodsucker lair. Three days I was partying with those sons of bitches, at times taking on two or even three together. After some quality time with yours truly the bloodsucker problem at Zaton is all but over. The bastards keep their tentacles tucked in at all times.

Dobre, povim ti, jak zabit kontrolery. Nedavno jsem narazil na hromadu artefaktu a rozhodl se je schovat, protoze uz mi zada nevydrzela. Na ceste zpet jsem dorazil ke svemu ukrytu a tam to bylo, kontroler, klidne sedel primo na vrchu. A ted jsem si rikal: "Kontroler nebo zadny kontroler, musim dostat zpatky svoje veci." Pak jsem si uvedomil, ze pokud se budu chranit necim, jeho manipulacni blaboly na me nebudou fungovat. Takze jsem vzal kus kovove mrize, kterou jsem nasel pobliz, a zacal se priblizit k oblude. Do te doby, nez si uvedomila, co se deje, jsem ji vystrelil cely zasobnik do hlavy. Prave kdyz se pokousela me ovladat, zasadil jsem ji posledni ranu pazbou od pusky a bylo hotovo.

Okay, I'll tell you how to kill controllers. The other day I chanced upon a buttload of artefacts and decided to stash them while still en route 'cause my back couldn't hack it any-more. On the way back I got to my stash and there it was, a controller, chilling right on top of it. Now I thought to myself, 'Controller or no controller, I got to get my shit back.' Then I realized that if I shield myself with something its manipulation bullshit won't work on me. So, I picked up a metal grate that I found lying around and started sneaking up on the beast. By the time it woke up to what was going on I pumped off a clip into the cocksucker's head. Just as it started trying to control me I gave it a final bash with my rifle butt and that was that.
Aha! To je nejaky pribeh, Flinte.
Ah! Now that's some story, Flint.
Flint je opravdovy chlap, to je jiste.
Flint's a real man, that's for sure.

No tak, jsem si jisty, ze vis o ceste ze Zatonu... Ne? No, pruvodce drive udelal obrovsky vylet. Co jsem udelal ja, bylo vytvorit zkratku primou linii, nova myslenka. Vyzkousel jsem par mist a rychle jsem nasel cestu pres anomalie. Takze jsem tuhle informaci prodal pruvodci a ted tudy vezme vsechny.

Well, I'm sure you know about the path from Zaton... No? Well, the guide used to take a massive detour. What I did was create a shortcut by cutting across a straight line, a novel idea. I tried a few places and worked out the way through the anomalies pretty quick. So I sold that info to the guide and now he takes everyone that way.

Slysel jsi o Oaze? Samozrejme jsi o ni slysel. Ja na druhou stranu jsem tam opravdu byl. Byl jsem prvni clovek, ktery objevil cestu tam, jakysi prukopnik. Tam neni zadne mutanti nebo proklate anomalie. Je to tiche jako hrbitov a plne artefaktu. Byl jsem tam jen pred par dny. V nedeli, vis to... Vest te tam? Ha! Omlouvam se, ale nechci tam tlacenici. Nic osobniho.

You heard about the Oasis? Of course you've heard of it. I, on the other hand, have actually been there. I was the first person to work out the way to get there, a pioneer if you will. There ain't no mutants or friggin' anomalies there. It's quiet as a graveyard and full of artefacts. I was there only a few days ago. Sunday, do you know that... Lead you there? Ha! Sorry, but I don't want it getting crowded. Nothing personal.

No, mam spoustu pribehu na vypraveni. Povidal jsem ti uz o tom, jak jsem pracoval pro vedce? Takze jednoho dne jsem zavital do jejich bunkru, zvedavy, co tam delaji. Nejprve byli vsichni v soku. Ale pak rekli: "Ty jsi presne to, co potrebujeme prave ted." Ukazalo se, ze chteli nastavit sva zarizeni pod anomaliemi. Samozrejme ti spratci si nechteli hrat s tim sami, tak mi slibili penize a dalsi veci. Takze jsem rekl: "No, to je v poradku, ale ty veci musi stat za to!" Musel jsem se plazit po te oblasti a hledat anomalie, ale nebylo to tak tezke jako dostat od tech blbecku penize za odmenu.

Well, I've got a lot of stories to tell. Did I tell you about my time working for the scientists? So, one day I go and pop in to their bunker, real curious to see what they're up to in there. At first they're all in shock. But then they go, 'You're exactly what we need right now.' It turns out they wanted to set up their devices under anomalies. Obviously the eggheads didn't feel like doing it themselves, so they promised me cash and other goodies. So I was like, 'Well, that's fine, but the goodies better be worth it!' I had to crawl around that area looking for anomalies but it wasn't half as hard as getting those nerds to fork up their award money.

Muze byt par lidi, kteri si mysli, ze Flint klame. No, muzou se zeptat kohokoli na zakladne o mne. Dokonce i tym profesionalnich lovcich, kdyz me videl nedavno, rikali vsichni: "Bez tebe to nezvladneme, Flinte. Nemuzeme to udelat bez tebe." Lovili chimeru, takze jsem musel temto "profikum" ukazat, jak se to dela. Moje munice je opravdu jednoducha. Jen se rovnou vrhnu do ukrytu. Zanechali tam jednoho novacka u vchodu, aby drzel oci na svestkach. Samozrejme, rano, jakmile ten novacek videl tu bestii, predral se ze slipu a utekl, takze jsem si musel s tim poradit sam. Uspesne, jak vidis, he-he-he...

There might be a few folk who think that Flint is telling lies. Well, they can ask anyone at the base about me. Even the squad of pro hunters, when they spotted me the other day they were all like, 'We need you, Flint. We can't do it without you.' They were hunting a chimera, so I had to show these 'pros' how it's done. My ammo is real friggin' simple. I just head straight into the lair. They left one rookie by the entrance to keep an eye out for it. Of course, come morning, as soon as the newbie saw the beast he shat his pants and legged it, so I had to deal with it myself. Successfully, as you can see, he-he-he...
Blahopreji k pripojeni k Duty! Jdi za mnou! Vlevo, vpravo, vlevo, vpravo...
Congratulations on joining Duty! Follow me! Left, right, left, right...
Vidis? Kdyz chces, zvladnes to. Je cas slozit prisahu.
See? You can do it when you want to. Time to take the oath.
Prisahas, ze budes slouzit Duty s odvahou a poctivosti, ze budes chranit lidskost pred utoky Zony a vzdy budes nasledovat kodex?
Do you swear to serve Duty with courage and integrity, to protect humanity from the Zone's aggression, and always follow the code?
Proc jen tak stojite? Posadte se a promluvme si!
Why do you standing around for? Have a seat and let's talk!
Nemame prisnou hierarchii. Ziskate nasi uctu a ziskate mnoho nasledovniku. Nicmene, behem mise poslouchame rozkazy velitele bez otazek.
We don't have a strict hierarchy. Earn our respect, and you'll get plenty of followers. However, when on a mission we obey the commander's orders without question.

Respektujeme svobodu nasich clenu a dalsich stoparu a verime, ze Zona je otevrena vsem. Je to nejvetsi dar, ktery lidstvo kdy dostalo, je to prilezitost pro obrovsky skok v nasem vyvoji a kazdy musi to pochopit.

We respect the freedom of our members and other stalkers, and we believe that the Zone is open to all. Being the greatest gift humanity has ever received, it's an opportunity to take a tremendous leap in our development, and everyone needs to understand that.
Stalker! Could you come over here?
You'd be better off speaking to Strider.
Strider je ten, s kym bys mel mluvit.
Strider is the one you ought to talk to.
Muzeme tu cely den sedet, ale nedostaneme se nikam.
We can sit around here all day, but that won't get us anywhere.
There's nothing but mutants around here.
Prvni vec, kterou musime udelat, je zjistit, kde vlastne jsme.
The first thing we need to do is work out where the hell we are.
Mame smulu, bez ohledu na to, co udelame.
Vyborne! To je presne to, co potrebujeme.
Pozor, pozor! Tady Hermann. Vedecka laborator je pod utokem. Na nejakou dobu nebudeme vpoustet stopare.
Attention, attention! This is Hermann. The science laboratory is under attack. We won't be allowing stalkers in for a while.
Pozor, pozor! Tady Hermann. Nas mobilni laborator je znovu otevrena pro stopare.
Attention, attention! This is Hermann. Our mobile laboratory is open to stalkers once again.
Stalkere! Musim te varovat, ze vstup do bunkru s zbrani je prisne zakazan.
Stalker! I must warn you that entering the bunker with a weapon is strictly prohibited.
Stalkere! Pri vstupu do vyzkumneho zarizeni musis zbran schovat.
Stalker! You must holster your weapon by the entrance to the research facility.
You hear me? Holster your weapon!

...jakoukoli cestou, vzdycky skoncime na stejnem miste. Stale se nemuzu privyknout tomuto oparu. Je divne, ze Chepurnoy zmizel beze stopy. Mozna nasel unikovou cestu... Den sesty. Dosla nam voda. Plukovnik se zblaznil a zastrelil dva lidi zblizka a pak sebe. Ted jsem sam v tehle proklete anomalii. Kdybych nechal vypadnout spojeni s velitelstvim, mohli by nas zachranit. A Duty by neexistovala. Zajimalo by me, jak by se veci vyvinuly... Ach, to je jedno! Ten kapitan Tkachenko zemrel pred dlouhou dobou. A tenhle general Tkachenko z Duty pujde za nim. To je... spravedlnost, predpokladam.

...whichever way we go, we always end up at the same exact spot. I still can't get used to this fog. It's weird that Chepurnoy disappeared without a trace. Maybe he found a way out. ... Day six. We've ran out of water. The Colonel flipped his lid and shot two people at point blank range, and then himself. Now I'm on my own in this damn anomaly. If I hadn't fixed for our communications with HQ to go down, they could've rescued us. And Duty wouldn't have existed. I wonder how things would've turned out. ... Ah, screw it! That Captain Tkachenko died a long time ago. And this General Tkachenko of Duty will follow him. That's... Justice, I suppose.
...find a way out. Help! We're running low on...
...uz to nevydrzime dlouho. Nemame vodu uz dva dny. Zadame o zachrannou misi! Hel...
...much longer. We've been without water for two day. Requesting a rescue mission! Hel...
...potrebujeme okamzitou pomoc! Nevydrzime dele nez tri...
...require immediate assistance! We won't hold out for more than three...
Nemel jsi sem prijit, stopari! Ted budes potravou pro cervy.
You shouldn't have come here, stalker! Now you'll be wormfood.
Ahoj! Vzdycky je hezke videt novou tvar v nasi bunkru.
Hello! It's always nice to see a new face in our bunker.
Is that everything? Good bye then.
No tak, pojdte sem. Co pro vas mohu udelat?
Ehh... very well, come on over. What can I do for you?
Yes, you have my undivided attention.
Okay, udelejme to rychle. Cim rychleji skoncime, tim vetsi mame sanci prezit.
Okay, let's do this fast. The quicker we finish the more chance we have of staying alive.
Byly provedeny cteni alfa, beta a gama zareni.
Alpha, beta and gamma radiation readings taken.
Blizime se ke konci. Sken torzniho pole je temer hotovy.
We're getting there. The torsion field scan is almost done.
Skoncili jsme tady, stalkeru. Ted se rychle z tehle diry dostaneme ven!
We're done here, stalker. Now let's get the hell out of here!
Hey! Are you covering us, or what?
Stalker! What the hell are you doing?!
Utoci na nas! Stalkeru, co to...?
They're attacking us! Stalker, what the...
Zvukova data ziskana pro vsechny rozsahy.
Acoustic data acquired for all ranges.
Zatim byla ziskana zvukova data pro dva rozsahy.
Acoustic data collected for two ranges so far.
Stingray-4, ozvi se! Ozvi se, zatracene! Stingray-4, rozumis? ... Pozor, skupina Stingray! Tady Stingray-1. Poloha pro nouevakaci je B-Dva-Osm. Opakuji, B-Dva-Osm!
Stingray-4, come in! Come in, dammit! Stingray-4, do you read? ... Attention, Stingray group! This is Stingray-1. The emergency evacuation position is B-Two-Eight. I repeat, B-Two-Eight!

Dva tela... Vypada to, ze zahynuli pri havarii. ... Vsechno cenne bylo vypleneno a palubni pocitac byl vycisten. Ale cerna skrinka je stale nedotcena. ... Zajimave. ... Predpokladam, ze dobry technik bude schopen z ni vytahnout informace a pote je dekodovat.

Two bodies... Looks like they died in the crash. ... Everything of value has been looted and the on-board computer has been wiped clean. But the black box is still intact. ... Interesting. ... I reckon a decent technician will be able to extract the information on it and then decode it.
Je to zablokovane a neni tu zadne tlacitko. Mam pocit, ze nekdo se musi dostat do ridiciho pokoje, aby to vyresil.
It's blocked, and there's no button. I get the feeling someone's going to have to make for the control room to solve this one.
Pockam tu dole a budu nam kryt zada, ok?
I'll wait down here and cover our backs, okay?
Sakra, vedel jsem, ze sem nemeli chodit.
Damn, I knew we shouldn't have come here.
Neni smysl tu jen tak postavat, to je jiste.
No point standing around here, that's for sure.
Mam pocit, ze jsme to zvladli.
My gut feeling is that we've made it.
Tak... Co tak zmacknout to tlacitko?
So... How about pressing the button?
Great! The gate has no power.
Pozor! Tady neco neni v poradku.
Man, they don't let up, do they.
Mmmh... neco tu neni v poradku.
Mmmh... neco tu taky citim jako spatne.
Mmmh... something feels wrong here too.
Hej, bud opatrny s tou veci, jo?
Hey, you'll be careful with that thing, all right?
Mam divny pocit, a ne ten dobry druh.
I'm getting a strange feeling, and not the good kind.
Hej! Takze se pohneme nebo co?
Hey! So, are we moving or what?
Proc jsem se to vubec do toho pustil?
Why did I even get into this?
K certu s timto mistem! Nemuzu se dockat, az odsud zmizim.
The hell with this place! I can't wait till I'm outta here.
Nemuzu uverit temhle blbostem, co mi rikali. "Nemej starosti, rizeni je snadne jako kolac." Vole!
I can't believe this shit they told me. 'Don't worry, piloting is easy as pie.' My ass!
Quiet! Keep it nice and quiet!
Budeme si povidat, az odsud vypadneme.
We'll talk once we get out of here.
Tohle rozhodne neni cas na rozhovor.
This is hardly the time to talk.
Ooh... stop it! You're hurting me!
Hej, vrat se! Je to nebezpecne.
Uvidime, jestli existuje zpusob, jak se pres to dostat.
Let's see if there's a way of getting through this.
Prijdte! Nasel jsem cestu, jak se pres to dostat.
Come! I've found a way through.
Hm... jdi tudy jednou, mozna je to tvoje posledni.
Hm... go this way once, it may be your last.
Tudy vede cesta. Doufejme, ze povede nekam, kde to nebude tak smrtici.
Okay, there's a way through here. Let's hope it leads somewhere a little less deadly.
Takze... brana je zablokovana, co? Hmm... Ja nevim... Mozna se da otevrit z ridici mistnosti?
So... the gate is blocked, huh? Hmm... I don't know... Maybe it can be opened from the control room?
Pokracuj, kamarade! Mam tvuj zadek kryty. Neboj se.
Keep moving, buddy! I've got your rear covered. Don't you worry.
No, ja budu... To je nadhera!
Dvere jsou otevrene tamhle. Pujdeme tudy?"
Door's open over there. Shall we go that way?
Podivejte se! Zmackni to tlacitko nebo tak neco, jo?"
Look it! Press the button or something, yeah?
There's been a power cut, huh-huh...
Hej, nechod tam! Je to tam zavrene.
Hey! Don't go there! It's closed off.
Blesk z tlamy vpravo... ehm... Tedy vlevo.
Muzzle flash on the right... er... I mean, left.
Poslouchej, na tehle veci by mely byt packy, kterymi se daji veci zapinat.
Listen, there should be levers on this thing that you can turn stuff on with.
Hej, chlape! Prestan ztracet cas. Delej to dost dlouho a sami se ztratime.
Hey, man! Quit wasting time. Do it long enough and we'll get wasted ourselves.
Vite, ono to tady neni tak spatne... Myslim, ze to tu neni tak zle.
You know, it's not so bad here... I think.
S vernymi prateli po boku ani tenhle pruser neni tak spatny.
With loyal friends by your side even this shit ain't that bad.
Je dobre, ze jsem se rozhodl te nasledovat. Jak jinak bych mohl videt misto, jako je tohle?"
It's a good thing I decided to follow you. How else could I've seen a place like this?
Poslouchej, ted neni nejlepsi cas na pokec.
Listen, this isn't the best time to chat.
Budu k tobe uprimny. Ted neni ani cas, ani misto na rozhovor.
I'll be honest with you. This is neither the time nor the place to talk.
Nas pritel z armady je mrtvy.
Our Monolith comrade has been killed.
Hej, clovece! Kam jdes? Pojdme na tom pracovat spolecne!
Hey, man! Where are you going? Let's work together on this one!
Brana je zablokovana. Na tvem miste bych se porozhledl po ridici mistnosti.
The gate is blocked. If I were you, I'd have a look around the control room.
Zustanu tady a budu kryt pristupy.
I'll stay here and cover the approaches.
The door is open. Shall we go?
Jsme tu na otevrenem prostranstvi. Jdeme!"
We're out in the open here. Let's move!
Vypada to, ze k brane neni privadena energie.
Looks like there's no power being supplied to the gate.
Transformator. Ty si pamatuji z detstvi.
A transformer. I remember these from my childhood.
Tady neni nejlepsi misto na krouceni palcu, pojdme!"
This isn't the best place to twiddle your thumbs, let's go!

The gate is blocked, and there's no button here. Anyone feel like going to the control room and seeing if there's anything there to help us?

Hm... energie k brane byla prerusena.

Well, bro... let's rock and roll!
Priprav se na ty nejlepsi, zemri jako ostatni.
Mess with the best, die like the rest.

Drz se, bracho! Musime jit porad kupredu.
Keep up, bro! We've got to keep moving forward.
Jaky to neporadek! Za takovou vec bys na nasi zakladne dostal na prdel.

Stalkerove mi pomohli dostat se do Pripjati.
Stalkers helped me to get to Pripyat.

Put your weapons on the ground, now!

Nestrilejte! Jsem porucik Sokolov, druhy pilot Stingray-4. Jsem na ceste na nouzovou pozici B28.
Proc myslis, ze jsme tady, pro zabavu? Proc takova spoust? Copak nevidis, ze jsme tu vsichni pratele? Ja a agentka D-De... jsme toho hodne zazili. Ver mi, ze to tak je.
What do you think we're here for, fun? Why so trigger-happy? Can't you see that we're all friends here? Me and agent D-De... have been through a lot. Trust me on that.
A je mi uplne jedno, kdo pro koho pracuje.
And I don't give a rat's ass who's working for who.
I have no business with the army...
Majore, kdybyste neco potreboval, promluvte si s plukovnikem.
Major, speak to the Colonel if you need something.

Plukovnik Kovalsky je osoba, se kterou mate mluvit, pane.

Majore, jestli vam to nevadi, mohl byste tu zbran schovat do pouzdra?"

Poslouchejte, majore, schovejte si tu zbran do pouzdra, ano? Nezastrelime vas, mate me slovo.
Listen, Major, holster your weapon, would you? We won't shoot you, you have my word.

No, tohle byla slusna zakladna. Ta stara nas udrzela nazivu; vic si nemuzeme prat. Ale ted se musime dostat k ptakum a letet domu.
Well, this was a decent base. The old girl kept us alive; can't ask for more than that. But now we got to get to the birds and fly home.

Colonel, why did comms go down?
